Maya (AE): New RFI thread from Peregrine. They want a short packet: capability matrix, POC runbook, pricing comparison vs self-host, and confirmation on HSM support + audit exports. Need reply in 3 business days.

Ravi - Solutions: I'll draft the 2-page capability matrix and a one-page POC runbook. Include a checklist: network prep, PKCS#11 validation, IAM role for S3 export, and acceptance criteria.

Jordan (Infra): For audit export push to customer S3 we need an IAM write role. Minimal example policy: "s3:PutObject" to arn:aws:s3:::<bucket>/prefix/*. Also note data retention sizing for 12 months.

Maya (AE): Procurement also asked for an exit/rollback note for the POC and a statement that we don't retain key material. LegalBot, can you provide wording?

LegalBot: Boilerplate: "Customer retains sole ownership of keys. Redwood may store only encrypted references. Upon termination we will coordinate key zeroization within 7 business days unless otherwise agreed." Adding to packet.

Ravi - Solutions: Quick capability matrix snippet to include:

```
Capability | Supported | Notes
HSM (PKCS#11) | Yes | Thales/Luna/CloudHSM supported; provide model for FIPS check
Per-tenant audit export | Yes | Push via IAM role or presigned export, 12mo retention
Private control plane | Yes | VPC peering or VPN; network prep required
POC length | 4 weeks | Onboard, integrate, perf, acceptance
Pricing | Usage + reserved | Offer POC credit and 90-day promo option
```

Emily (Peregrine): We'll send HSM model and network diagram tomorrow. Prefer S3 push with per-tenant prefixes and role-based restrictions.

Jordan (Infra): Ballpark numbers for packet: Dedicated medium pool ~$45k/mo; self-hosted comparable ~$90-110k/mo including ops; show 40-60% TCO delta. I'll add p95/p99 for 8k/32k contexts by EOD tomorrow.

Maya (AE): Action items: Ravi - capability matrix + runbook by tomorrow noon. Jordan - cost comparator + perf numbers by EOD. LegalBot - attach key ownership clause. I'll assemble and send procurement pack once complete.

Ravi - Solutions: Noted. Will flag any hard blockers.

Maya (AE): Thanks team. I'll loop customer contact Emily once we have the packet. :thumbsup:
